name: T01

theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-a0
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01]
  have a : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h5
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: private-a0
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M hd hM hN hP hm
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h1 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h2 : N * (m.S * M) ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hN
  have h3 : 0 < M * M * m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hd
  have key : m.modeDet N M = M * M * m.detJ - N * (m.S * M) + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  rw [key] at hm
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-a0
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hP hS
  have h : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M = (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) ^ 2 + (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S ^ 2) * M ^ 2 := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
    grind
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) ^ 2 + (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S ^ 2) * M ^ 2 :=
    Int.add_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (Int.sq_nonneg M))
  rw [← h] at h2
  exact Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h2 (by omega)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

theorem H02 : ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B := by
  intro r B C
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B

author: private-a0
name: H04
source:
theorem H04 : ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ := by
  intro r B C₁ C₂ h1 h2
  rw [H02] at h2 ⊢
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁

author: private-a0
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s hdet hp hD hex
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hex
  have e : ∀ x : Int, 0 ≤ x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    first
      | exact Int.sq_nonneg x
      | (rcases Int.le_total 0 x with h0 | h0
         · have := Int.mul_nonneg h0 h0
           grind
         · have := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos h0) (Int.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos h0)
           grind)
  have hp2 : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    grind
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (e _) (e _)
  have h6 := T06 m (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) hdet hp2 hN hD h
  unfold Scope.modeN Scope.modeM at h6
  have hn1 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    grind
  have hk : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hD (e s)
  have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn2 hk
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2
